title: Extension after fixing a list of coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $L$ be a list of coordinates, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. If every coordinate in $L$ is free in $\rho$, then fixing the coordinates in $L$ according to the signs encoded by $x$ produces an assignment that agrees with $\rho$ at every coordinate where $\rho$ was not free.
hypotheses_covered: Every coordinate in $L$ is free in $\rho$
